notes.title: Mythical Mayhem 2025 August Update
notes.content: [h1]Endless Campaign Game[/h1][p]I am slightly disappointed that this announcement wasn't announcing a release date but to be honest I am behind my schedule of where I would have liked to be.  I continue to toil away at this feature and it is a larger effort than I had initially scoped.  Currently this feature is over 85% done and now its down to bug fixes, extra details and testing.  Once released this extra play mode will be included as part of the base game, every current and future released DLC will enhance it but none will be required to play it. [/p][p][/p][h1]DLC Pandemonium Portals Update[/h1][p]Pandemonium Portals is over 95% completed.  I could likely release this in a few weeks but I am going to stick with the original plan and have Pandemonium Portals release at the same time as the Endless Campaign update.  As mentioned before you will not need Pandemonium Portals to play the Endless Campaign but it will have some features that support and enhance the Endless Campaign as well as being a full stand alone DLC like the other DLCs that have been released.  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3804780/Mythical_Mayhem__Pandemonium_Portals/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h1]Future of Mythical Mayhem[/h1][p]After the Endless Campaign and Pandemonium Portals is released their will likely be a break and also we might have 1 or 2 minor updates if required, to fix any game issues.  As always any reported bugs will be fixed as soon as possible. I don't want to set hard time lines but this could finish out 2025.  After this I am thinking of creating a small free to play Demo and then doing a pirate/sea faring themed DLC expansion.  I also still have ideas for a few more DLCs so we will see where things end up.  As always I plan to continue to monitor and remain actively engaged with all Fans of Mythical Mayhem (on the steam boards and Mythical Mayhem Discord).   [/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Thanks to all the fans that have supported Mythical Mayhem and your continued support and patience.[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Mythical Mayhem 2025 May Update
notes.content:
[h1]Endless Campaign Game[/h1]
I am currently working away planning one of the most requested features for Mythical Mayhem the Endless Campaign.  This is going to be released as part of the main game at no additional charge.  Quite a few things will be similar to the main campaign but there will be differences.  It will not have campaign balance and it will not have an overarching story focus, the story focus will be quite light.  There will still be Side Stories, Market, Campaign Commerce, Choices for Quest rewards.  I will be introducing a new campaign resources and deck manipulation will play a bigger role. Hopefully the Endless Campaign will be able to be released towards the end of summer.  It's initial state that it releases will be built in a way that is fully playable but with most things could possible be improved upon in later updates.


[h1]DLC Pandemonium Portals Update[/h1]
Pandemonium Portals is the 3rd planned DLC for Mythical Mayhem.  The plan is Pandemonium Portals will release the at the same time as the Endless Campaign update; you will not need Pandemonium Portals to play the Endless Campaign but it will have some features that will play into that update as well as some standard items that work similar to the other DLCs like new campaign quests, new heroes, new arch villains,  new foe sets and new minions along with other new items.  Price will likely be similar to Twisting Sands.


[h1]Future of Mythical Mayhem[/h1]
After the Endless Campaign and Pandemonium Portals is released their will likely be a minor break and also we might have 1 or 2 minor updates if required, to fix any game issues.  As always any reported bugs will be fixed as soon as possible. Looking further ahead towards the end of 2025 I will look to do a smaller DLC possible the pirates themed one.  After that into 2026 I still have ideas for a few more DLCs so we will see where things end up.  Also Mythical Mayhem has 3 items I would love to see: 1 different video resolution support.  2 Support for localization.   3. Multi-Player.  I have investigated these items in depth and despite me wanting all of these features the reality is Mythical Mayhem will most likely never have any of them.  I don't like to deal in absolutes but the reality is any these features would have needed to be designed from the start; who knows maybe someday I might develop a Mythical Mayhem 2    but that is still just an idea for the future.  As always I plan to continue to monitor and remain actively engaged with all Fans of Mythical Mayhem (on the steam boards and Mythical Mayhem Discord).


[i][b]Thanks to all the fans that have supported Mythical Mayhem along its journey.  I am looking forward to continuing our journey together.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Mythical Mayhem 2024 News
notes.content:
First off thanks to those that have supported Mythical Mayhem for its first year of full release. 

In reflection it's been an exciting year for Mythical Mayhem. In early March this year Mythical Mayhem released from early access.  Their were numerous updates, enhancements and bug fixes that followed. In late summer the first DLC Judgment Night released.


[h1]Twisting Sands Update[/h1]
Twisting Sands is the 2nd DLC for Mythical Mayhem.  I had planned to try and release it for 2024 but it will be delayed a little bit. As of right now it is close to 90% done; I am pleased to say the campaign writing is complete and the Steam store page has been approved. I am not going to provide a specific date but as with everything I have done with Mythical Mayhem it will be released as soon as it is ready.     Initially Twisting Sands DLC was planned to be similar in size to Judgment Night however Twisting Sands has grown a bit, it will release with 7 new campaign quests; 7 new heroes; 3 new Arch Villains; 3 New Foe Sets; and 2 New Minions.


[h1]Future of Mythical Mayhem[/h1]
After Twisting Sands is released their may be 1 or 2 minor updates to fix any game issues and as always any reported bugs will be fixed as soon as possible. After Twisting Sands is released Mythical Mayhem will undergo a period of reflection. There is still so much I would still love to do and explore content wise like an Endless Campaign DLC and a larger DLC along with at least 2 more smaller DLCs.  There are a few other items outside of content that may be explored but until they can be further perused and investigated they are just ideas.  I plan to continue to monitor and remain actively engaged with all Fans of Mythical Mayhem (on the steam boards and Mythical Mayhem Discord).


[i][b]All the best to you and yours over the festive season.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Mythical Mayhem Q4 2023 News
notes.content:
It has been a great year of development for Mythical Mayhem. I am pleased to report the game is ahead of schedule and has grown in scope and features.  I wanted to give an update on a few items in development and the future of Mythical Mayhem.

[h1]Campaign[/h1]
At this point the last major item for an official release is the campaign.  Currently this is more than 75% done their is one chapter left to complete, one major system left to implement.  This last major system is a campaign Market feature, which is going to take a bit of time to finish implementing but I believe it to be a nice and important addition.

[h1]Updates[/h1]
Until now we have been able to do regular monthly updates, as we get close to the end of early access this will begin to slow.  We are planning 1 more fairly large update that should launch in early December.  After this unless there are critical bugs and a hot fix required their will be only 1 to 2 additional updates that come some time in 2024.

[h1]V1 Release[/h1]
By V1 most of the card content should already be released.  The major feature that be released is the campaign with 35 scenarios it should take an average playthrough very roughly 10 hours of play.  Also being released will be Steam Achievements.

[h1]Release Date[/h1]
We are certainly ahead of schedule of before end of 2024.  Unless things go off the rails I am going to say Mythical Mayhem should be able to release out of early access by mid year 2024, and we will be aiming to release before then.

[h1]Price Increase[/h1]
Early in 2024 before the end of early access we will be raising the price of Mythical Mayhem by between 20% to 50%. This mostly reflects how much more the scope of the game has grown.

[h1]After Early Access[/h1]
We would love to do a some DLCs with varied ranges in scope from very minor cosmetic options to larger card set releases and everything in-between.  However this is all in the future and will depend on a few factors of which the number one priority is staying focused and getting the game out of Early Access to a V1 release.

notes.title: Mythical Mayhem 2025 May Update
notes.content:
[h1]Endless Campaign Game[/h1]
I am currently working away planning one of the most requested features for Mythical Mayhem the Endless Campaign.  This is going to be released as part of the main game at no additional charge.  Quite a few things will be similar to the main campaign but there will be differences.  It will not have campaign balance and it will not have an overarching story focus, the story focus will be quite light.  There will still be Side Stories, Market, Campaign Commerce, Choices for Quest rewards.  I will be introducing a new campaign resources and deck manipulation will play a bigger role. Hopefully the Endless Campaign will be able to be released towards the end of summer.  It's initial state that it releases will be built in a way that is fully playable but with most things could possible be improved upon in later updates.


[h1]DLC Pandemonium Portals Update[/h1]
Pandemonium Portals is the 3rd planned DLC for Mythical Mayhem.  The plan is Pandemonium Portals will release the at the same time as the Endless Campaign update; you will not need Pandemonium Portals to play the Endless Campaign but it will have some features that will play into that update as well as some standard items that work similar to the other DLCs like new campaign quests, new heroes, new arch villains,  new foe sets and new minions along with other new items.  Price will likely be similar to Twisting Sands.


[h1]Future of Mythical Mayhem[/h1]
After the Endless Campaign and Pandemonium Portals is released their will likely be a minor break and also we might have 1 or 2 minor updates if required, to fix any game issues.  As always any reported bugs will be fixed as soon as possible. Looking further ahead towards the end of 2025 I will look to do a smaller DLC possible the pirates themed one.  After that into 2026 I still have ideas for a few more DLCs so we will see where things end up.  Also Mythical Mayhem has 3 items I would love to see: 1 different video resolution support.  2 Support for localization.   3. Multi-Player.  I have investigated these items in depth and despite me wanting all of these features the reality is Mythical Mayhem will most likely never have any of them.  I don't like to deal in absolutes but the reality is any these features would have needed to be designed from the start; who knows maybe someday I might develop a Mythical Mayhem 2    but that is still just an idea for the future.  As always I plan to continue to monitor and remain actively engaged with all Fans of Mythical Mayhem (on the steam boards and Mythical Mayhem Discord).


[i][b]Thanks to all the fans that have supported Mythical Mayhem along its journey.  I am looking forward to continuing our journey together.[/b][/i]
